faq.question: Is Kongunadu a government college?
faq.answer: The verified institution is a private aided autonomous college affiliated to Bharathiar University. Aided and unaided programme categories coexist; government financial assistance does not make every route government-owned or free.

faq.question: Are the aided and unaided courses the same admission record?
faq.answer: They are separate admission and fee categories even where the degree title is similar. Select the exact category when applying and confirm its programme-specific qualification, fee and available seats.

faq.question: Which teaching languages are verified?
faq.answer: The institution’s dated self-study programme table explicitly records English for the continuing named science, commerce and English-literature degrees, and Tamil for M.A. Tamil. Later variants without exact medium evidence remain outside the supported subset.

faq.question: Is the next intake month confirmed?
faq.answer: The current programme and qualifying route are verified, but an exact first-entry month is not shown where unconfirmed. Historical application deadlines are not promises of a future window; follow the operative college notice.

faq.question: Do the fee amounts mean annual tuition?
faq.answer: A displayed reported fee can retain a course-total or other native basis internally and is indicative when supplied by a secondary source. Historical combined charges are not converted into current annual tuition. Obtain the exact programme/category invoice before payment.

faq.question: Can a diploma or another degree be used instead?
faq.answer: Use the exact programme qualification route. Some college tables list diploma or equivalence alternatives, but those need the appropriate university eligibility confirmation. A general alternative for one course should not be applied across all programmes.

faq.question: Can overseas qualifications be accepted?
faq.answer: Current parent-university rules describe AIU equivalence and eligibility documentation for qualifications from outside India. Confirm the exact programme and foreign/NRI admission category separately; a general document requirement does not establish an unrestricted overseas route.

faq.question: Are hostel rooms or placements guaranteed?
faq.answer: Confirm accommodation availability, allocation and costs separately. A programme listing, practical component, career service or published placement example does not guarantee a room, internship or employment outcome.
